about: Bank of Maharashtra provides various banking products and services in India. It operates through Treasury, Corporate/Wholesale Banking, Retail Banking, and Other Banking Operations segments. The company accepts savings, current, term, and recurring deposits, as well as provides capital gain account schemes.
